model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms across six medical specialties, comparing a base model (Mistralv0.2-Base) with versions fine-tuned on each of the six specialties. The horizontal axis is labeled "Per-specialty terms" and contains six categorical groups: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, arranged from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately -27 to -22, with tick marks at integer intervals. Within each group, seven bars are displayed: a light blue/lavender bar representing Mistralv0.2-Base, followed by bars representing fine-tuned models on Cardio (light beige), Gastro (light peach/salmon), Infect (medium orange), Neuro (darker orange), Obstetrics (dark brown-orange), and Pediatrics (dark brown). The Mistralv0.2-Base bar consistently reaches approximately -22 across all six specialty groups, making it the tallest (closest to zero) bar in every group. For the Cardio group, the fine-tuned bars vary substantially, with some reaching around -22 and others extending down to approximately -26.5. In the Gastro group, the fine-tuned bars range from roughly -22 to about -24.5. The Infect group shows fine-tuned bars clustered between approximately -22 and -23.5. The Neuro group displays a wider spread, with some fine-tuned bars reaching near -22 and others dropping to around -26. The Obstetrics and Pediatrics groups show fine-tuned bars ranging from approximately -22 to -24.5. The bars are not sorted by value within each group but rather follow a consistent color ordering corresponding to the legend. The base model bar is visually distinguished by its lighter blue color and is consistently the first bar in each group.
